headline: Apple's Powerful Macs Delayed Until 2027 for Big Processor Upgrades
summary: Apple's M7 series chips with on-device AI processing coming in 2027. No Pro or Max M6 chips expected.
details: Apple is reportedly planning to release its M6 chip this year, but the more powerful M6 Pro and M6 Max variants might be skipped. Instead, the company is fast-tracking the M7 series, which is expected to launch in the first half of 2027.

The M7 series will include major advancements in on-device AI processing and is expected to have Pro, Max, and Ultra variations. This could leave Apple's most powerful Macs without significant upgrades until 2027.
The M5 Ultra is still on track to launch this year as part of a new Mac Studio. The M7 Ultra is expected to release sometime in 2028.
caption:
Apple's most powerful Macs might wait until 2027 for big processor upgrades. What's behind the delay?

Apple is reportedly planning to release its M6 chip this year, but the more powerful M6 Pro and M6 Max variants might be skipped. Instead, the company is fast-tracking the M7 series, which is expected to launch in the first half of 2027.

The M7 series will include major advancements in on-device AI processing and is expected to have Pro, Max, and Ultra variations. This could leave Apple's most powerful Macs without significant upgrades until 2027.

The M5 Ultra is still on track to launch this year as part of a new Mac Studio. The M7 Ultra is expected to release sometime in 2028.
